meta.title: Image Alt Text Auditor demo
meta.description: Uploads six images, four of them missing alt text, and opens the audit screen where they can be fixed inline.
meta.author: jdyach

'persisted_preferences', array_merge( array( 'core/edit-post' => array( 'welcomeGuide' => false ), 'core' => array( 'welcomeGuide' => false ), '_modified' => gmdate( 'c' ), ), $extra ) ); } // Six media library images: four without alt text (they appear in the audit), // two with good alt text (they don't). $demo_images = array( array( 'studio-shapes', 'homepage-hero', '' ), array( 'field-study', 'team-retreat-photo', '' ), array( 'notebook', 'blog-header-notebook', '' ), array( 'studio-shapes', 'product-shot-final-v2', '' ), array( 'field-study', 'about-page-illustration', 'Abstract illustration of cream, terracotta and gold shapes on a sage green field.' ), array( 'notebook', 'newsletter-banner', 'Terracotta circle and sage half circle over a cream card on a gold background.' ), ); foreach ( $demo_images as $i => $img ) { $source = get_theme_file_path( "assets/images/{$img[0]}.webp" ); if ( ! file_exists( $source ) ) { continue; } $upload = wp_upload_bits( "{$img[1]}.webp", null, file_get_contents( $source ) ); if ( ! empty( $upload['error'] ) ) { continue; } $id = wp_insert_attachment( array( 'post_mime_type' => 'image/webp', 'post_title' => $img[1], 'post_status' => 'inherit', 'post_date' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - $i * HOUR_IN_SECONDS ), ), $upload['file'] ); wp_update_attachment_metadata( $id, wp_generate_attachment_metadata( $id, $upload['file'] ) ); if ( '' !== $img[2] ) { update_post_meta( $id, '_wp_attachment_image_alt', $img[2] ); } }
